fusions.name: Web Scuttle
fusions.desc: Scuttles through every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 4 damage, with a 50% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Drop on Prey
fusions.desc: Rushes 5 tiles to the target and deals 14 damage, leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Silk Drag
fusions.desc: Spins a line of silk 6 tiles across ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward. Anything it catches moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Tangle Rewards
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions lifts, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
